name: incremental-fact-store
body: The shared delta/manifest preparation (`rust.apg.incremental.prepare.prepare`, its `Prepared` target/removed sets and `PipelineInput` reuse plan) that decides the phase-2 target set and carries the recorded content identity the seed guard compares. It lives in the shared store while the seeded DB is worktree-local, which is why the guard exists and why a spec-only change-set can slip through it.
